subject: Renewal + Expansion: MSA updates & order form carve-outs (Novara)
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@novara.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novara.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + expansion: initial scope and timing

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Novara is ready to move forward with a renewal and a scope increase — we want to extend the MSA by 18 months (from 12) and add an initial 30% capacity uplift across our primary workspace with an optional burst pool. Attached is a proposed order form and a capacity worksheet for your ops team to review (Attachment: Novara_OrderForm_Proposal_v1.xlsx).

Procurement asked that all contract changes be tracked in a single redline and that any retention/data processing changes be called out separately so their legal/regulatory team can sign off. Can Redwood provide a consolidated redline to the MSA (we marked Exhibit C as the main area for changes)? Also, we have a short procurement window: signature needed by July 2 to meet our fiscal cycle.

Best,
Elena
Director, Vendor Contracts
Novara Systems

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novara.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: initial scope and timing

Elena —

Thanks for the clear ask and the worksheet. We can do a single consolidated redline for the MSA and a separate exhibit-level mark for data retention and embeddings usage. Marissa — can you pull the most recent MSA + Exhibit C (production telemetry/sample retention language) and prepare an initial redline?

Operational notes: the 30% uplift looks fine from a capacity standpoint; we should confirm expected qps distribution so our autoscaling/burst policy maps correctly. Karthik — once legal has the redline, please prioritize a quick review for the indemnity and data residency carve-outs Elena mentioned.

Elena — we’ll aim to return a redline by EOD Thursday (June 24). If procurement truly needs signature by July 2, we’ll fast-track approvals internally.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Rios <tom.rios@novara.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novara.com, Elena Morales <elena@novara.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: initial scope and timing

Grace — quick follow-up from procurement: 1) We need a specific billing cadence for the added capacity (monthly vs. quarterly). 2) Novara's legal wants a carve-out that anonymized embeddings generated from PII are excluded from retention for more than 90 days unless explicitly consented — is that something Redwood can operationally enforce and put into Exhibit C? 3) Please surface any SLA credits changes for the higher tiers.

Also copying pricing contact in case the unit economics change materially.

--Tom
VP, Procurement
Novara Systems

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Rios <tom.rios@novara.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: redline in progress

Tom/Grace/Elena —

Attached is our first pass redline (Attachment: redline_draft_20270625.docx). Key callouts in the draft: 1) Term extension to 18 months with auto-renew opt-out language; 2) Added an "Anonymized Embeddings" carve-out in Exhibit C that limits retention to 90 days for embeddings derived from PII; we included a customer opt-in checkbox for longer retention; 3) A clarified billing cadence section in the order form (monthly by default with an option for quarterly invoicing); 4) Minor SLA credit adjustments for the uplift tier (see section 5.2).

Karthik — legal flagged two items you should weigh in on: (a) the indemnity cap for third-party model output (we proposed tying to fees paid in the prior 12 months), and (b) the fallback routing language for cross-region failover (Novara will want more control).

Elena/Tom — please review the redline and call out any items you need prioritized for the July 2 signature target. If procurement needs us to accept carving out certain data classes entirely, note that that may require an ops-side controls review.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redline_draft_20270625.docx (document)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, Elena Morales <elena@novara.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: redline in progress

Team —

Reviewed Marissa's draft. High-level legal guidance and proposed edits: 1) Indemnity: instead of a flat tie to prior 12 months fees, propose a sliding cap — 3x monthly recurring charges or $250k, whichever is higher, for indemnity related to model output (limits risk while giving Novara recourse). 2) Data carve-out: the 90-day limit on embeddings derived from PII is fine, but require a mutual control checklist (we'll append an Exhibit D) that lists technical controls (field hashing, differential access, deletion hooks). 3) Cross-region failover: replace "Novara will control routing" with a "mutual escalation" process and a documented runbook; we can offer a guaranteed warm-standby in the region for critical workloads at an incremental fee.

I've attached a short PDF with the proposed Exhibit D checklist (Attachment: MSA_exhibit_C_proposed_changes.pdf). Stephanie — once you confirm the ops feasibility of the warm-standby approach and deletion hooks, we'll finalize wording.

Karthik
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novara.com>, tom.rios@novara.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: final proposed language and next steps

Hi Elena/Tom —

Following up after ops/engineering sync. Quick summary of what we can and cannot do without an additional integration timeline: 1) 90-day retention on anonymized embeddings — yes, we can enforce this automatically for the specified PII-derived fields; we'll implement a deletion hook and a periodic verification job (proposed language in the attached redline). 2) Warm-standby in-region — possible as an add-on for critical workloads; estimated incremental monthly fee and a 3-week provisioning window. 3) Billing cadence — monthly billing is standard; we can set up quarterly invoicing but require a 30-day advance notice for accounting.

Next steps: a) if Novara accepts the Exhibit D checklist approach, we will finalize the redline and circulate a clean and tracked copy for signature; b) Marissa/Grace to confirm final pricing for the warm-standby add-on (Marissa, can you confirm by EOD Tue?).

Elena/Tom — if you're good with the direction above, we can route this through DocuSign and aim for the July 2 signature.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Solutions Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: MSA_exhibit_C_proposed_changes.pdf (pdf)
